SupportAddedFireDamagePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Gain Fire Damage but deal less Cold and Lightning Damage.

flavourText: Those that serve the Liege of the Lightless are his, utterly.
Blood, flesh, and soul are fodder to bend to his will.
Under a Lich Lord, not even death is an escape.
SupportAmanamusTithePlayer.name: Amanamu's Tithe

SupportAncestralAidPlayer.description: Supports Strikes you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until you have Blocked a certain number of Hits, but will be Ancestrally Boosted when used. After use, this Blocked Hit counter will reset. Cannot Support Channelled Skills or Skills which already have a Condition for use.
SupportAncestralAidPlayer.name: Ancestral Aid

SupportAncestralCallPlayer.description: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.
SupportAncestralCallPlayer.name: Ancestral Call I

SupportAncestralCallPlayerTwo.description: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.
SupportAncestralCallPlayerTwo.name: Ancestral Call II

SupportArmourBreakPlayer.description: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.
SupportArmourBreakPlayer.name: Armour Break I

SupportArmourBreakPlayerThree.description: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.
SupportArmourBreakPlayerThree.name: Armour Break III

SupportArmourBreakPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.
SupportArmourBreakPlayerTwo.name: Armour Break II

SupportArmourDemolisherPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.
SupportArmourDemolisherPlayerTwo.name: Armour Demolisher II

SupportArmourExplosionPlayer.name: Armour Explosion

SupportArmsLengthPlayer.description: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies, causing Knockback from those Hits to be significantly more effective.
SupportArmsLengthPlayer.name: Arms Length

SupportAtaluiBloodlettingPlayer.description: Supports any Skill, turning a portion of its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit. Supported Skills Gain a portion of their Life cost as extra Physical Damage.
flavourText: Atazek and Atalui rose, battered and dark, bleeding from a hundred
different wounds. She gave her brother a sinister grin. "Shall we
show them what happens to those who challenge the Vaal?"
SupportAtaluiBloodlettingPlayer.name: Atalui's Bloodletting

SupportAutoReloadPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.
SupportAutoReloadPlayer.name: Auto Reload

SupportBarbsPlayer.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills. Supported Skills deal your Thorns Damage on Hit after you've Retaliated with Thorns Damage.
SupportBarbsPlayer.name: Barbs I

SupportBarbsPlayerThree.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills. Supported Skills deal your Thorns Damage on Hit twice after you've Retaliated with Thorns Damage.
SupportBarbsPlayerThree.name: Barbs III

SupportBarbsPlayerTwo.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills. Supported Skills deal your Thorns Damage on Hit after you've Retaliated with Thorns Damage.
SupportBarbsPlayerTwo.name: Barbs II

SupportBattershoutPlayer.description: Supports Warcry Skills. Supported Skills Consume Fully Broken Armour to trigger Physical Damage explosions on Enemies within their range but cannot themselves Break Armour.
SupportBattershoutPlayer.name: Battershout

SupportBeheadPlayer.description: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill.
SupportBeheadPlayer.name: Behead I

SupportBeheadPlayerTwo.description: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal two Modifiers from Rare monsters they kill.
SupportBeheadPlayerTwo.name: Behead II

SupportBleedPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.
SupportBleedPlayer.name: Bleed I

SupportBleedPlayerFour.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Melee Physical Damage to Bleeding Enemies, but be unable to inflict Bleeding itself. Supported Skills also inflict Incision on Hit.
SupportBleedPlayerFour.name: Bleed IV

SupportBleedPlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Bleeding.
SupportBleedPlayerThree.name: Bleed III

SupportBleedPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.
SupportBleedPlayerTwo.name: Bleed II

SupportBloodFountainPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Blood which will Leech Life to Allies within it.
SupportBloodFountainPlayer.name: Font of Blood

SupportBloodMagicPlayer.description: Supports any Skill, turning its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit.
SupportBloodMagicPlayer.name: Lifetap

SupportBloodlustPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to deal more damage against Bleeding enemies, but preventing them from inflicting Bleeding.
SupportBloodlustPlayer.name: Bloodlust

SupportBrambleslamPlayer.description: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills create Hazardous Brambles on the ground that activate after a duration. Enemies which come in contact with these thorns take damage and are Maimed. A maximum of 20 Brambles are allowed at one time. Does not modify Skills used by Minions or Totems.
SupportBrambleslamPlayer.name: Brambleslam

SupportBranchingFissuresPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.
SupportBranchingFissuresPlayer.name: Branching Fissures I

SupportBranchingFissuresPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.
SupportBranchingFissuresPlayerTwo.name: Branching Fissures II

SupportBrinkPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Heavy Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Heavy Stun.
SupportBrinkPlayer.name: Brink I

SupportBrinkPlayerTwo.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Stun.
SupportBrinkPlayerTwo.name: Brink II

SupportBrutalityPlayer.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.
SupportBrutalityPlayer.name: Brutality I

SupportBrutalityPlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types, as well as giving Hits from that skill a chance to ignore Physical Damage reduction.
SupportBrutalityPlayerThree.name: Brutality III

SupportBrutalityPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.
SupportBrutalityPlayerTwo.name: Brutality II

SupportBrutusBrainPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, causing those Minions to be unable to deal or take Damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.
flavourText: Shavronne gleefully raised her arms to the sky as lightning
flashed. She'd done it! Her creation was perfect! Invincible.
Immortal! But she soon realized there was one piece missing...
SupportBrutusBrainPlayer.name: Brutus' Brain

SupportCannibalismPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.
SupportCannibalismPlayer.name: Cannibalism I

SupportCannibalismPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.
SupportCannibalismPlayerTwo.name: Cannibalism II

SupportCirelsCultivationPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing you from having more than one of that Totem but granting significant benefits for Supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.
flavourText: The oldest and greatest fortress on Wraeclast was grown, not built.
She Who Waited planted their seeds in a time of ash and snow.
Now, the gate of the Taisce is unassailable, yet open to all.
SupportCirelsCultivationPlayer.name: Cirel's Cultivation

SupportClashPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Damage while you have a lower percentage of your Life remaining than the target struck, but less Damage when the reverse is true.

SupportConcoctPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.
SupportConcoctPlayer.name: Concoct I

SupportConcoctPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.
SupportConcoctPlayerTwo.name: Concoct II

SupportCoolheadedPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Ignite applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportCoolheadedPlayer.name: Cool Headed

SupportCorruptingCryPlayer.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.
SupportCorruptingCryPlayer.name: Corrupting Cry I

SupportCorruptingCryPlayerThree.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to inflict massive amounts of Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect, at the cost of your Life.
flavourText: The water used to cool the Locus of Corruption ran red
as blood, bright as flame, and bubbled with strange heat.
"Drink," he offered. "Suffuse your flesh with power!"
SupportCorruptingCryPlayerThree.name: Paquate's Pact

SupportCorruptingCryPlayerTwo.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.
SupportCorruptingCryPlayerTwo.name: Corrupting Cry II

SupportCraterPlayer.description: Supports Melee Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Fissures when you land. Cannot Support Totem Skills, and does not modify Skills used by Minions.
SupportCraterPlayer.name: Crater

SupportDaressosPassionPlayer.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing them to require significantly less Glory to use.
flavourText: "I raised my eyes to look upon my death. Instead, I saw her.
Merveil. Fighting had always been about survival. Now the
fight became about something much greater... love."
SupportDaressosPassionPlayer.name: Daresso's Passion

SupportDauntlessPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills cannot be used unless you have been stationary for a certain duration, but deal increasingly more damage the longer you are stationary. Cannot support Skills which have a reservation, are Triggered, have a cooldown or have another usage Condition.
SupportDauntlessPlayer.name: Dauntless

SupportDazingCryPlayer.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to Daze Enemies on use.
SupportDazingCryPlayer.name: Dazing Cry

SupportDeadlyIgnitesPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

SupportDeadlyIgnitesPlayerTwo.name: Searing Flame II

SupportDeepCutsPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.
SupportDeepCutsPlayerTwo.name: Deep Cuts II

SupportDefyPlayer.name: Defy I

SupportDefyPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky and Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used if you are Surrounded.
SupportDefyPlayerTwo.name: Defy II

SupportDesperationPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used while Surrounded.

SupportDirestrikePlayerTwo.name: Direstrike II

SupportDoubleBarrelPlayerThree.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed. Supported Skills will also automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

SupportDoubleBarrelPlayerTwo.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.
SupportDoubleBarrelPlayerTwo.name: Double Barrel II

SupportEinharsBeastritePlayer.description: Supports Melee Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill for a lengthy duration, while being unable to damage enemies not on low Life. Does not modify skills used by Minions.
flavourText: "You must cut the beast, like this," he told the wide-eyed
and forgetful woman. "The juiciest parts are in the middle!"
She nodded, and began relearning the way of the wilds.
SupportEinharsBeastritePlayer.name: Einhar's Beastrite

SupportElementalArmamentPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.

SupportElementalArmamentPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.
SupportElementalArmamentPlayerTwo.name: Elemental Armament II

SupportEnragedWarcryPlayerTwo.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.
SupportEnragedWarcryPlayerTwo.name: Enraged Warcry II

SupportExecutePlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life, as well as dealing more damage while you are on Low Life.

SupportExecutePlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

SupportFanTheFlamesPlayerTwo.description: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them. The explosion Spreads the initial enemy's Ignite to other enemies Hit.
SupportFanTheFlamesPlayerTwo.name: Fan The Flames II

SupportFireExposurePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when Igniting.
SupportFireExposurePlayer.name: Fire Exposure

SupportFirePenetrationPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Fire resistance.
SupportFirePenetrationPlayer.name: Fire Penetration I

SupportFirePenetrationPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits ignore enemy Fire resistance.
SupportFirePenetrationPlayerTwo.name: Fire Penetration II

SupportFlamePillarPlayer.description: Supports any Skill you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Ignite on Hit to create pillars of flame, but cannot themselves inflict Ignite. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Ignite, and does not modify the Skills of Minions.

SupportFreshClipPlayerTwo.name: Fresh Clip II

SupportHaemocrystalsPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Bleeding on Hit to create explosive blood-filled crystals, but cannot themselves inflict Bleeding. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Bleeding.
SupportHaemocrystalsPlayer.name: Haemocrystals

SupportHardyTotemsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.
SupportHardyTotemsPlayer.name: Hardy Totems I

SupportHardyTotemsPlayerThree.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life. Totems created by Supported Skills explode on death, dealing Physical damage based on their Life.
flavourText: A scavenging warrior found Tawhoa meditating in a grove.
"There is only so much jade in this world," intoned the god.
"Take my gift to your tribe. Ironwood will grow for all time."
SupportHardyTotemsPlayerThree.name: Tawhoa's Tending

SupportHardyTotemsPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.
SupportHardyTotemsPlayerTwo.name: Hardy Totems II

SupportHeavyStunEndurancePlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.
SupportHeavyStunEndurancePlayerTwo.name: Enduring Impact II

SupportHerbalismPlayer.name: Herbalism I

SupportHerbalismPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.
SupportHerbalismPlayerTwo.name: Herbalism II

SupportHolyDescentPlayer.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Consecrated Ground when you land.
SupportHolyDescentPlayer.name: Holy Descent

SupportIgniteDurationPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to be inflicted less often but last longer.
SupportIgniteDurationPlayer.name: Eternal Flame I

SupportIgniteDurationPlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to refresh Ignites on Critical Hit.
SupportIgniteDurationPlayerThree.name: Eternal Flame III

SupportIgniteDurationPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to last longer.
SupportIgniteDurationPlayerTwo.name: Eternal Flame II

SupportIgnitePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.
SupportIgnitePlayer.name: Ignite I

SupportIgnitePlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite and causing inflicted Ignites to deal their damage more quickly.
SupportIgnitePlayerThree.name: Ignite III

SupportIgnitePlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.
SupportIgnitePlayerTwo.name: Ignite II

SupportInfernalLegionPlayerThree.description: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Burn. Damage dealt by the Burning is based off the Life of the supported Minion.
SupportInfernalLegionPlayerThree.name: Infernal Legion III

SupportInfernalLegionPlayerTwo.description: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Burn. Damage dealt by the Burning is based off the Life of the supported Minion.
SupportInfernalLegionPlayerTwo.name: Infernal Legion II

SupportInterludePlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful.
SupportInterludePlayer.name: Remnant Potency I

SupportInterludePlayerThree.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.
SupportInterludePlayerThree.name: Remnant Potency III

SupportInterludePlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.
SupportInterludePlayerTwo.name: Remnant Potency II

SupportJaggedGroundPlayer.description: Supports Slam skills. Supported Skills will consume Endurance Charges on use to create Jagged Ground.
SupportJaggedGroundPlayer.name: Jagged Ground I

SupportJaggedGroundPlayerTwo.description: Supports Slam skills. Aftershocks caused by Supported Slam Skills always create patches of Jagged Ground.
SupportJaggedGroundPlayerTwo.name: Jagged Ground II

SupportKaomsMadnessPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create many additional fissures at the cost of damage, speed, and area of effect.
flavourText: As King Kaom delved further into Wraeclast, so, too, did he
draw closer to the Beast. One night, in a nightmarish fit, he
swung his axe at his own men, slaughtering hundreds.
SupportKaomsMadnessPlayer.name: Kaom's Madness

SupportKnockbackPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Knock Back enemies.
SupportKnockbackPlayer.name: Knockback

SupportLastingGroundPlayer.description: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those surfaces to last longer.
SupportLastingGroundPlayer.name: Lasting Ground

SupportLifeLeechPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.
SupportLifeLeechPlayer.name: Life Leech I

SupportLifeLeechPlayerThree.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life and preventing Leech gained this way from being removed at full Life.
SupportLifeLeechPlayerThree.name: Life Leech III

SupportLifeLeechPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.
SupportLifeLeechPlayerTwo.name: Life Leech II

SupportLongFusePlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.
SupportLongFusePlayerTwo.name: Long Fuse II

SupportMarkForDeathPlayerTwo.description: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.
SupportMarkForDeathPlayerTwo.name: Mark for Death II

SupportMeatShieldPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

SupportMeatShieldPlayerTwo.description: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage.

SupportPersistentGroundPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer and only end when their duration expires.
SupportPersistentGroundPlayerTwo.name: Persistent Ground II

SupportQuillburstPlayer.description:
Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills trigger Quill Burst, which deals your Thorns Damage in an Area around the target struck. Quill Burst can only be triggered on Hit after you've
Retaliated with Thorns Damage.
SupportQuillburstPlayer.name: Quill Burst

SupportRagePlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.
SupportRagePlayer.name: Rage I

SupportRagePlayerThree.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit. Supported Skills have signficantly higher Attack speed while you are not at maximum Rage.
SupportRagePlayerThree.name: Rage III

SupportRagePlayerTwo.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.
SupportRagePlayerTwo.name: Rage II

SupportRageforgedPlayer.description: Supports any damaging skill that you use or trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.
SupportRageforgedPlayer.name: Rageforged I

SupportRageforgedPlayerTwo.description: Supports any damaging skill that you use or trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage, with a chance to skip spending Rage while still benefitting as though it had. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.
SupportRageforgedPlayerTwo.name: Rageforged II

SupportRagingCryPlayer.description: Supports Warcry skills, causing them to grant you Rage on use depending on counted monster Power.
SupportRagingCryPlayer.name: Raging Cry

SupportRallyPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills Consume all Endurance Charge on use, causing you to restore a percentage of your maximum Life for each Charge Consumed.
SupportRallyPlayer.name: Rally

SupportRefractionPlayer.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.
SupportRefractionPlayer.name: Refraction I

SupportRefractionPlayerThree.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing Enemies within their area to gain Refractive Dissolution, a Debuff which lowers Elemental Resistances.
SupportRefractionPlayerThree.name: Refraction III

SupportRefractionPlayerTwo.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.
SupportRefractionPlayerTwo.name: Refraction II

SupportReinforcedTotemsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.
SupportReinforcedTotemsPlayer.name: Reinforced Totems I

SupportReinforcedTotemsPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.
SupportReinforcedTotemsPlayerTwo.name: Reinforced Totems II

SupportRelentlessRagePlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself. On spending Rage with any skill you will gain a Buff. Using Supported Skills consumes this Buff to grant you Rage.
SupportRelentlessRagePlayer.name: Relentless Rage

SupportRendingApexPlayer.description: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to Break Armour based on a portion of Attack damage dealt.
SupportRendingApexPlayer.name: Rending Apex

SupportRetaliatePlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.
SupportRetaliatePlayer.name: Retaliate I

SupportRetaliatePlayerTwo.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage and are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.
SupportRetaliatePlayerTwo.name: Retaliate II

SupportReveberatePlayer.description: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills that have a chance to Aftershock have increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time.
SupportReveberatePlayer.name: Reverberate

SupportRipPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself or that you Trigger. Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies create a Blood Remnant. Blood Remnants increase your Life regeneration rate for a short while after being collected.
SupportRipPlayer.name: Rip

SupportRupturePlayer.description: Supports skills that Hit Enemies. Supported skills Aggravate Bleeding on Hitting Heavily Stunned Enemies.
SupportRupturePlayer.name: Rupture

SupportRustedSpikesPlayer.description: Supports Skills which deal Damage with Hits. When Supported Skills Pin an Enemy, they also Aggravate Bleeding on that Enemy.
SupportRustedSpikesPlayer.name: Rusted Spikes

SupportSeeRedPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills. Bleeding inflicted with Supported Skills lasts significantly longer, but enemies you inflict Bleeding onto with Supported Skills will move and Attack faster.
SupportSeeRedPlayer.name: See Red

SupportSelflessRemnantsPlayer.description: Supports Skills that generate Remnants, causing those Remnants to affect Allies in your Presence when collected instead of you.
SupportSelflessRemnantsPlayer.name: Selfless Remnants

SupportShortFusePlayer.description: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, shortening the time before Detonation.
SupportShortFusePlayer.name: Short Fuse I

SupportShortFusePlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, massively shortening the time before Detonation at the cost of Damage.
SupportShortFusePlayerTwo.name: Short Fuse II

SupportSkitteringStonePlayer.description: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.
SupportSkitteringStonePlayer.name: Skittering Stone I

SupportSkitteringStonePlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.
SupportSkitteringStonePlayerTwo.name: Skittering Stone II

SupportSlamAftershocksPlayer.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, causing them to create simultaneous Aftershocks behind the Slam, but lowering Aftershock damage and area of effect with Supported Skills. Cannot Support Skills which create Fissures.
SupportSlamAftershocksPlayer.name: Tectonic Slams

SupportSparPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.
SupportSparPlayer.name: Spar

SupportSplinteringTotemPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.
SupportSplinteringTotemPlayer.name: Splinter Totem I

SupportSplinteringTotemPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.
SupportSplinteringTotemPlayerTwo.name: Splinter Totem II

SupportSteadfastPlayer.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold while Channelling them.
SupportSteadfastPlayer.name: Steadfast I

SupportSteadfastPlayerTwo.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold and Ailment Threshold  while Channelling them.
SupportSteadfastPlayerTwo.name: Steadfast II

SupportStoicismPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.
SupportStoicismPlayer.name: Stoicism I

SupportStoicismPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.
SupportStoicismPlayerTwo.name: Stoicism II

SupportStompingGroundPlayer.description: Supports Travel skills, causing your footsteps to crack the earth and emit damaging shockwaves while using the skill.
SupportStompingGroundPlayer.name: Stomping Ground

SupportStunPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.
SupportStunPlayer.name: Stun I

SupportStunPlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun significantly more quickly, at the cost of Damage.
SupportStunPlayerThree.name: Stun III

SupportStunPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.
SupportStunPlayerTwo.name: Stun II

SupportSyzygyPlayer.description: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Hits from Supported Skills are considered Crushing Blows against Enemies which are both Ignited and Fully Armour Broken. Hits with Supported Skills that Heavily Stun Ignited and Fully Armour Broken Enemies will Intimidate them.
SupportSyzygyPlayer.name: Syzygy

SupportTearPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself or that you Trigger. On-Kill effects caused by Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies have a chance to occur twice.
SupportTearPlayer.name: Tear

SupportThornskinPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportThornskinPlayer.name: Thornskin I

SupportThornskinPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportThornskinPlayerTwo.name: Thornskin II

SupportTirelessPlayer.description: Supports Warcry Skills. Attacks Empowered by Supported Skills have a chance not to lower the Empowerment count of Supported Skills when they are used.
SupportTirelessPlayer.name: Tireless

SupportTremorsPlayer.description: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain multiple independent chances to cause Aftershocks, but deal less Damage.
SupportTremorsPlayer.name: Tremors

SupportUhtredAuguryPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided exactly two other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
flavourText: Studying the ill omens of the stars, Uhtred came to suspect
something was very wrong among the first Kalguurans.
Olroth, Vorana, Medved... three there were. Three dangers.
SupportUhtredAuguryPlayer.name: Uhtred's Augury

SupportUhtredExodusPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided no other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
flavourText: By the time Uhtred realised the truth, only Vorana remained
to defend them. While the rest fled, she implanted her flesh
with gems and set forth alone to face the endless hordes.
SupportUhtredExodusPlayer.name: Uhtred's Exodus

SupportUhtredOmenPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided exactly one other support is used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
flavourText: Day and night, his priests followed each of the Kalguuran
heroes. When Medved disappeared, Uhtred grew even more
paranoid. Now, only two remained... Olroth and Vorana.
SupportUhtredOmenPlayer.name: Uhtred's Omen

SupportUnabatingPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Armour, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.
SupportUnabatingPlayer.name: Unabating

SupportUnderminePlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills Consume Maim on hit, Breaking a percentage of the Maimed target's Armour in doing so. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Maim.
SupportUnderminePlayer.name: Undermine

SupportUnsteadyTempoPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Attacking with Supported Skills will cycle through various effects, with the first Attack in sequence inflicting Hobble on you. The second and third Attacks in sequence will powerfully scale chance to Critically Hit and overall damage, respectively, at which point the cycle will reset. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.
SupportUnsteadyTempoPlayer.name: Unsteady Tempo

SupportUnyieldingPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, a percentage of Damage taken is Recouped as Life, with the percentage scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the Supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.
SupportUnyieldingPlayer.name: Unyielding

SupportUpheavalPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create an additional fissure at the cost of damage and speed.
SupportUpheavalPlayer.name: Upheaval I

SupportUpheavalPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional fissures at the cost of damage and speed.
SupportUpheavalPlayerTwo.name: Upheaval II

SupportUrgentTotemsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.
SupportUrgentTotemsPlayer.name: Urgent Totems I

SupportUrgentTotemsPlayerThree.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly. Totems created by Supported Skills have increased Attack and Cast Speed.
SupportUrgentTotemsPlayerThree.name: Urgent Totems III

SupportUrgentTotemsPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.
SupportUrgentTotemsPlayerTwo.name: Urgent Totems II

SupportUruksSmeltingPlayer.description: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger. Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills permanently increases the Physical Damage taken by those affected, up to a cap.
flavourText: The volcano roared, but there was no thunder, only the boom
of Uruk's hammer. Wraeclast had forgotten the old alliance,
but by the Molten One's will, the fires would rage again.
SupportUruksSmeltingPlayer.name: Uruk's Smelting

SupportUulNetolsEmbracePlayer.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Break Armour.
flavourText: "The Lords could not breathe, so they grew new lungs.
The Lords could not venture, so they grew new skin.
The Lords were alone, so they grew us, to serve them."
SupportUulNetolsEmbracePlayer.name: Uul-Netol's Embrace

SupportVanguardPlayer.description: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.
SupportVanguardPlayer.name: Vanguard I

SupportVanguardPlayerTwo.description: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.
SupportVanguardPlayerTwo.name: Vanguard II

SupportVitalityPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.
SupportVitalityPlayer.name: Vitality I

SupportVitalityPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.
SupportVitalityPlayerTwo.name: Vitality II

SupportVolcanicEruptionPlayer.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills trigger Volcanic Eruption on Hit against Ignited Enemies.
SupportVolcanicEruptionPlayer.name: Volcanic Eruption

SupportXophsPyrePlayer.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Ignites.
flavourText: "They drank until only dust remained. Ate until their gums
bled rust. Such was their greed, the only thing that remains
of the Broken Sun... is the Red Pyre, the Torus Eternal."
SupportXophsPyrePlayer.name: Xoph's Pyre

SupportZerphisLegacyPlayer.description:
Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Supported Skills gain a Glory requirement, and build Glory when you spend Life on Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage and have significantly
 increased area of effect.
flavourText: "It was the quality of his heinous acts that set him apart, not
the quantity... all of the physical trauma inflicted occurred
while the victim was still alive. Perhaps this was the key."
SupportZerphisLegacyPlayer.name: Zerphi's Infamy

TriggeredBattershoutExplosionPlayer.description: Deal Physical Area Damage based off of the Broken Armour of the target which this explosion was Triggered from.
TriggeredBattershoutExplosionPlayer.name: Battershout

TriggeredBrambleslamPlayer.description: Hazardous thorns damage and Maim enemies with which they come in contact.
TriggeredBrambleslamPlayer.name: Brambles

TriggeredCraterPlayer.description: Creates multiple Fissures when landing with Supported Skill.
TriggeredCraterPlayer.name: Crater

TriggeredFanTheFlamesPlayer.description: Causes a fiery explosion in a cone behind the target, dealing Attack damage.
TriggeredFanTheFlamesPlayer.name: Fan the Flames

TriggeredFanTheFlamesPlayerTwo.description: Causes a fiery explosion in a cone behind the target, dealing Attack damage.
TriggeredFanTheFlamesPlayerTwo.name: Fan the Flames

TriggeredFlamePillarPlayer.description: Deal Fire Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the Consumed Ignite.
TriggeredFlamePillarPlayer.name: Flame Pillar

TriggeredHaemocrystalsPlayer.description: Deal Physical Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the Consumed Bleed.
TriggeredHaemocrystalsPlayer.name: Haemocrystals

TriggeredQuillburstPlayer.description: Deal your Thorns Damage in an Area. Cannot Hit the target this was Triggered from.
TriggeredQuillburstPlayer.name: Quill Burst

TriggeredSkitteringStonePlayer.description: Creates Skittering Stone Minions from shattered objects created by Supported Skill.
TriggeredSkitteringStonePlayer.name: Skittering Stone

TriggeredSkitteringStonePlayerTwo.description: Creates Skittering Stone Minions from shattered objects created by Supported Skill.
TriggeredSkitteringStonePlayerTwo.name: Skittering Stone

TriggeredSplinterExplosionHardyTotems.description: Deals Physical Damage in an area, based on Totem Life.
TriggeredSplinterExplosionHardyTotems.name: Tawhoa's Vengeance

TriggeredVolcanicEruptionPlayer.description: Fire molten Projectiles from the struck target, which will land nearby dealing Attack damage in an area.
TriggeredVolcanicEruptionPlayer.name: Volcanic Eruption

UnbreakableSupportPlayer.description: Supports any skill that you can use, making you harder to Stun while using it.
UnbreakableSupportPlayer.name: Unbreakable
